product_overview: The Design System provides a polished visual language and interaction foundation for a professional product experience. It defines colors, typography, spacing, elevation, and component styling to support a calm, high-clarity interface.
core_goals: Apply a consistent visual system across the product
Present content and tasks with strong readability and hierarchy
Use spacing, color, and elevation to reduce cognitive load
Create a premium, modern feel through minimalism and glassmorphism

features.name: Color and Surface Styling
features.description: Provides the core color palette and surface treatments used to establish a clean, professional interface.
user_flows: Open the product interface -> View the default light surface styling -> Observe primary and secondary accent colors applied consistently across interactive and informational areas
Open a screen with status feedback -> Complete a successful action -> Observe success styling reflected with the designated positive color

features.name: Typography Hierarchy
features.description: Defines the type scale and text styling used to make headings, body content, and metadata easy to scan.
user_flows: Open a content-heavy screen -> Review the page heading hierarchy -> Read supporting text and metadata with distinct size and weight differences
Open the interface on a smaller screen -> Observe the mobile heading scale -> Continue reading content with preserved legibility and hierarchy

features.name: Layout and Spacing System
features.description: Establishes a fixed desktop grid and fluid smaller-screen layout with consistent spacing rhythm.
user_flows: Open the product on desktop -> View content centered within the main container -> Scroll through sections separated by clear vertical spacing
Open the product on mobile -> View the fluid layout with side margins -> Navigate between sections without layout crowding

features.name: Elevation and Glassmorphism
features.description: Creates depth through translucent layers, soft shadows, and floating navigation or panels.
user_flows: Open a page with persistent navigation -> Scroll the content -> Observe the header remain visible with a translucent glass effect
Open a screen with layered panels -> Interact with the interface -> Observe elevated panels and modals distinguish themselves from the base surface

features.name: Component Styling
features.description: Applies consistent visual rules to buttons, inputs, cards, and other reusable interface elements.
user_flows: Open a form or action-oriented screen -> Review primary and secondary actions -> Use the consistent button styles to proceed through the task
Open a data or summary screen -> Inspect the cards and input fields -> Observe the soft fills, rounded corners, and subtle focus states

features.name: Hardy Cross Solver
features.description: Implements Hardy Cross method for hydraulic balancing

features.name: Pressure Analysis
features.description: Analyzing pressure distribution and PRV stabilization

features.name: Network Helpers
features.description: Utilities for network renaming and visualization

known_limitations.issue: WNTR compilation issue on Python 3.14 Windows
known_limitations.impact: Visualization and renaming features may fail if WNTR is not fully functional
